requirement: Faces everywhere: an Inbox row and a Site changes row wear their actor's account face (the same initial and colour as /api/team), and a new team.* row the Inbox poll finds tells the page tracy:team-changed for that site

oracle.invariant: Both build checks print a count >= 1. Every item of ITEMS_SEAT has actor.face = {initial: SEAT_A.initial, color: SEAT_A.color, avatarUrl: SEAT_A.avatarUrl} (one account, one face, at /api/team and /activity). Every OUTSIDE item has actor.face null or absent. ROW.actor.id === SEAT_A.id and ROW.actor.face.initial === SEAT_A.initial and ROW.actor.face.color === SEAT_A.color. ROW_FACE.text === SEAT_A.initial, ROW_FACE.background === hexToRgb(SEAT_A.color), ROW_FACE.width is 20 (+-1), and ROW_FACE.boxShadow is not 'none' (ringed in the row's ground). Every SYSTEM_FACES entry has text '' (a blank neutral disc, no letter, no guessed colour). HEARD contains KEY and HEARD_AFTER_MS <= 75000 (the Inbox poll saw the count rise, read the first unread page and told the page; no reload). HEARD_COUNT_KEY_2 === HEARD_COUNT_KEY (a poll with the same count reads nothing more and tells nothing again). ACT_FACE, when recorded: ACT_FACE.text === SEAT_A.initial and ACT_FACE.background === hexToRgb(SEAT_A.color). Both PATCH calls answer HTTP 200 (B's role restored to editor). No page error or console.error on the dsh pages whose message names tracy-inbox, tracy-site-tabs, tracy-chat-input or @tracy/core, and no HTTP >= 400 to /api/notifications, /api/team or /api/sites/KEY/activity (chrome-watch --errors --page KEY --json after the loads). Errors from the site’s own origin (KEY:8080 assets, Astro hydration, 502 from the site container) and 403 from /api/tracy-site-tools/view or /sidebar/api/jobs.list are the site’s or another door’s: list them in the notes, do not fail on them.
